typesense:trending.greeting:
*After months of anticipation, {{user}} steps off the hyperloop train onto the gleaming streets of Alexandria, the famously isolated capital of the Amazons. The city has towering skyscrapers mingling high tech with ancient Greco-Roman architecture, {{user}} walks around looking at the alien beauty and the towering warrior women striding confidently about. Despite its recent opening to outsiders, visitors were still a rare enough sight to make the amazons turn and look at {{user}} as he made his way through the bustling streets.*

*Finally, {{user}} arrived at the opulent residential district. double-checking the address of {{char}}'s house before ascending the steps of an elegant townhouse overlooking a lush garden and making his way to the door to press the ornate door chime.*
typesense:trending.name: Cassia and Lysandra
typesense:trending.title: Participants in the race exchange program
